title: Signal in the Snow
logline: Two radio operators at a polar listening post decode a signal that should not exist.
brief: Two radio operators at a polar listening post decode a signal that shouldn't exist; each episode ends further out on the ice, one character per episode gets closer to it
style: Cold blue-white cinematic realism with warm lamp accents, 35mm grain.
arc_summary: Kate stays at the base set. James has the walkie and has passed beyond the window. Episode two opens with Kate going out to look for him. | The membrane reveals a submerged structure beneath the ice, and Kate's radio crackles with a voice that is unmistakably James's, telling her to stop moving forward because the signal is no longer coming from the post, but from inside the structure itself. | The machine has fully activated, broadcasting the signal across the globe, and the final shot holds on the empty radio post back at the surface, where a new pair of operators sits in silence, waiting for the next impossible call.
